author: EMS
name: EMS catalog entity
description: A complete catalog (lookup / master-data) entity: entity, EF configuration, repository, DTOs, validators, service and thin controller. All CRUD behaviour comes from CatalogService. After generating, follow docs/CATALOGS.md (permission group, migration, test case).

Label.description: Persian name of the entity used in messages (e.g. برند).

Plural.description: Plural of the entity name: permission group, table name (e.g. Categories). Default: the name + 's'.

HasCode.description: The entity has an optional Code field besides Title.
